messages.subject: Executive Candidate Introduction | International Director & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear CEO Search India Team,

I am reaching out through your current official contact route following a failed delivery to an older address. I currently serve as Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, and bring more than 12 years across multinational mining, regulated banking, corporate affairs, government relations, ESG, stakeholder management and executive operations.

I am internationally mobile and interested in Director, Head, Country, strategic partnerships, external affairs, sustainability and business development mandates across India, the GCC and wider international markets.

Please find my executive CV attached for consideration by your search team.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
